notes: This file is a human-maintained overlay for research data that TTS does not encode structurally.
Topology (path nodes, forward edges, scores) comes from src/ResearchTrackData.ttslua.
Fill costs/rewards visible on the printed board/rulebook and verify them against the physical board.
Research cost keys: coin, compass, tablet, arrowhead, jewel, usableIdol.
A node or bridge may contain multiple rewards in a rewards array.
Supported reward primitives: GAIN_RESOURCE, DRAW_CARD, CLAIM_ASSISTANT, UPGRADE_ASSISTANT, BONUS_TILE.
SEQUENCE represents a compound effect; CHOOSE represents a player choice among reward options.
Unknown future reward types may still be recorded declaratively and will enter pendingRewards until implemented.
Use nodeOverrides only for irregular printed spaces, such as one physical space spanning levels 4 and 5.
templeArrivalPoints is [first, second, third, fourth] and must be recorded separately for each board.

nodeRewards.comment: Example of two rewards on one space.
